feedTitle: Shipping forecast for the North Irish Sea

items.title: Shipping forecast updated as of 11 June 2026 11:28pm
items.description:
##Current shipping forecast##

Valid for 24 HoursIssued on Thursday, 11 June 2026 at 11:00pm by Ronaldsway Met Office
##Warning##

Occasional strong winds tomorrow.


##Synopsis##

Low pressure near Iceland, driving associated fronts across the Irish Sea.


##Wind##

West or southwest 4 or 5 decreasing 3 or 4 for a time, then 4 or 5, occasionally 6 tomorrow afternoon.


##State of Sea##

Slight or moderate.


##Weather##

Fair, then occasional rain or drizzle tomorrow morning, clearing to become mainly fair tomorrow afternoon.


##Visibility##

Good, occasionally moderate in rain or drizzle.


##Outlook for the following 24 hours##


##Wind##

West or southwest 4 or 5, occasionally 6, increasing west 5 or 6 occasionally 7 early Friday night. Decreasing 4 or 5 Saturday morning, then 3 to 5 later.


##State of Sea##

Slight or moderate, building moderate for a time.


##Weather##

Mainly fair, risk of isolated showers for a time Saturday morning.


##Visibility##

Good, occasionally moderate in any showers.
